description: This file defines a template class 'CompressedTuple' implementing the Empty Base Optimization (EBO) for tuples, allowing efficient storage of empty classes by inheriting from them. It includes internal utilities for storage management, type traits, and member access functions, and is part of the Abseil C++ library's internal container utilities.

classes.name: absl::container_internal::CompressedTuple
classes.description: A tuple class optimized with Empty Base Optimization, capable of storing empty classes efficiently by inheriting from them.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Member functions to access tuple elements by index, with overloads for lvalue, const lvalue, rvalue, and const rvalue references.
